name: black_water
for: Mother of the Black Water: black water
notes: A low wave of near-black water 19 px tall (foam cap to ~21 px): a translucent teal band under the crest, a 1 px teal rim light along its back so it reads on dark ground, a hand-placed foam cap on the curling lip (morphing on twos), foam spilling down the face, spray off the crest, drips and a splash at its foot. Low: jump it. Facing +x, exported in place (12 frames @ 12 fps, seamless loop). Feet anchor: ground is canvas row 27; the front's leading edge is at canvas x 64; place that point on the ring's position.
